title: Cozy Condo minutes from Vanderbilt
description:
The Ideal West End Basecamp: Whether you are visiting a student at Vanderbilt, working at Centennial Medical Center, or exploring Marathon Village, this modern Queen Suite puts you in the center of Nashville's "Smart District."

The space
🌟 Property Highlights
Sleeps up to 4 guests, most comfortable for 2.

Spacious suite with a comfy queen bed

Modern bathroom with tile walk in shower 

Sleeper futon for extra guests

Smart TV for streaming your favorite shows

Full kitchen with all the essentials

Coffee maker for those morning pick-me-ups

Free Wi-Fi

Washer & Dryer

On-site parking (street parking available too!)

Just a 10-minute Uber ride or less to all the things!
